title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing authorization and CSRF checks in reset and check-in tasks in Visforms…
description: The Joomla extension Visforms versions 1.0.0 to 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 to 6.2.1 have missing authorization and CSRF protections in the reset submitted data and check-in form tasks. This vulnerability allows unauthorized users to perform these actions without proper checks.
